text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
One, two, three, four-r!
...Wait! Where am I? Am I a princess!?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Hey Princess!! Focus, focus!
You'll never be ready for the ball at this rate!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: "A ball!? Goodness, such a thing exists!?"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Yeeeees!
The prince is coming to see you too, you know☆

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I am utterly flabbergasted!
No wonder I had to go through so much dance trainingâ

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Awake at last? Hehe, quite the wild sleeper you are.
Falling out of bed during a nap...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Oh...? Did I fall asleep during special training...?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"Even though there's a ball going on...!
Pearl-san! Please, let's continue our dance...!"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
A ball? Speciiiial traaaaining...???
I have no idea what you're talking about, but...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I felt your burning soul!!
Okay! Let's daaaance!!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Woohoo! Nice dance! Keep it up!
Build up your courage in front of the crowd~~!!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Yes indeed! I shall intercept our prince with the finest dance possible~!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
And these thrilling steps!
I feel like they might even make me faster!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha!
Why are Kawakami and the others dancing~?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"Because there's a ball being held there!!
Umm, I forgot when it was, though!"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Who cares about the little details, I say~~~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The next day, Kawakami Princess's running became drastically sharper...!
